common_issues: display_unit 'inch' and 'clove' not in allowed list — must be 'piece'
prep_time_min of 480 (8 hours) for overnight soaking is unusual but technically accurate; acceptable
Dal Makhani: missing onion/garlic? Has both — correctly listed

Amritsari Chole: traditional pindi chana does NOT contain onion (it's the differentiator from regular chole). Recipe says onion paste fried dark — this is closer to Punjabi chole than authentic Pindi/Amritsari style. Acceptable simplification.
